name: Spain
summary: Iberian nation with exceptional solar and wind resource endowments. Generates over half its electricity from renewables while confronting desertification pressures across southern watersheds.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 2.08x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); periodic Saharan calima dust plumes sweep the Canary Islands and southern peninsula.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; tied with 2022 as hottest year on record in AEMET series.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Intense Mediterranean warming rate of +0.48 °C per decade over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.6% share of global fossil emissions; sharp decline driven by closure of all domestic coal plants.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Near global average; significant decarbonization achieved through wind and solar buildout.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Extensive pine, oak, and scrub woodlands covering ~185,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Historic clean grid achievement: wind (24.1%), solar (16.6%), and hydro (9.5%) crossed 50% threshold.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 95 people/km²; urban population fraction is 81.3%.
